pillars.name: The bank-balance illusion
pillars.purpose: Show why a current balance can overstate the amount available before future payments leave.
pillars.proofMode: Simple arithmetic and familiar payment timing examples.

pillars.name: What remains before payday
pillars.purpose: Own the practical question ClearTill is designed to answer.
pillars.proofMode: Balance minus entered costs still due before the next income date.

pillars.name: Manual by design
pillars.purpose: Frame user-controlled inputs and no bank connection as deliberate product choices.
pillars.proofMode: Product walkthroughs and privacy-conscious use cases.

pillars.name: Real-life one-off costs
pillars.purpose: Demonstrate how repairs, renewals and family costs change a short-term position.

pillars.name: Bills, dates and changing balances
pillars.purpose: Explain why the position changes as dates pass or the balance is updated.

pillars.name: Founder-led product insight
pillars.purpose: Explain the reasoning behind a calm, focused product.
pillars.proofMode: First-person design decisions without invented traction.

pillars.name: Worked illustrative examples
pillars.purpose: Make the calculation tangible without implying a customer result.
pillars.proofMode: Explicitly illustrative figures and visible arithmetic.

pillars.name: Product walkthroughs
pillars.purpose: Show how to create, update and revisit a position.
pillars.proofMode: Accurate screens or diagrams tied to verified features.
